scope: Solver-stage functionality and scaling diagnostic, not the 60-input performance regression or a full ECDLP experiment. WDSat's frozen Koblitz corpus does not encode the non-F2 a6 coefficients or these even-degree ONBs. This matched exploratory corpus preserves the parent invariants but does not satisfy its promotion gate.
hypothesis: The exact RR/image solver extends to non-F2 subfield coefficients and even field degree; dimension eight remains feasible in a 60-second supplemental enumeration budget.
curve: y^2+xy=x^3+t*x^2+t, where t is the smallest non-F2 ONB-coordinate relative trace of a basis vector to F4. Record and verify coefficients explicitly.
field_basis: Existing permuted type-II ONB, cyclic ring length 2n+1; no polynomial modulus parameter is used.
factor_base: Both signs of nonzero curve points with x in the first-d-ONB-coordinate F2 subspace V. This is not an F4-linear base or the subgroup E(F4).
domain: m=3 distinct nonzero abscissas, each different from target x. Finite affine targets, exact signed sum. Projected sorted x-tuples counted, not independent relation rows.
targets: One uniform affine target and one target sampled from signed factor triples per seed/field. Supported targets sampled from d6, then both strata kept identical at d6,d7,d8. Holdout seed fixed before execution; no tuning after its results. No witnesses or oracle sets are passed to any solver.
supplemental: All eight d8 targets get a cold hybrid enumeration run at 60 seconds regardless of the five-second result. This is an explicitly unmatched capacity diagnostic, never a Semaev speedup comparison.
validation: All affine GF64 targets at d4 against independent signed-triple and pair oracles for all three solvers. Every hybrid candidate compared to modular H|L_V. Exhaustive AS correctness at n6 and n9. Exact symbolic general-a6 S4/resultant identity. Every larger solution and completion checked against independent pair oracle and signed-point certificates.
boundary: For M signed factor-base points, at most 8*binom(M/2,3) signed triples before target exclusions. Uniform affine target support fraction is at most min(1,8*binom(M/2,3)/(#E-1)). This is a counting bound, not a runtime lower bound. No group/subgroup order or rho reference is measured in this stage panel; ratios remain null. The matched solver references are chained S3 and symmetric S4, in the same cold five-second resource budget.
falsification: Any oracle, support, identity or certificate mismatch invalidates the extension. A d8 supplemental timeout disproves reliable completion on this frozen panel within 60 seconds. A matched timeout is unknown, not UNSAT. No 20-percent speedup gate is claimed without calibrated full accounting and the required larger regression/full-DLP workload.
accounting: Every cell charges cold curve/AS setup, image setup or encoding/loading, search including failed candidates, extraction and verification. No factor-base point table or oracle is supplied to the solvers. Target generation and independent oracle work are recorded separately as harness validation costs. Hybrid field API counts include inversion expansion and all linear-map additions. SAT field counts exclude Boolean encoding/solving and cannot be compared as total costs. Exclusive phase timers; cumulative process RSS is not per-cell peak memory.
limits: Two fields, one coefficient family, two seeds, no timing repetitions, calibrated SAT operations, full DLP, subgroup, rho, independent-row rank or exponent fit. This is a functionality extension plus engineering diagnostics. Binary subfield curves only; odd-characteristic F_p^3 curves and subfield-linear factor bases remain future work. Frozen prior sources and results remain unchanged.
